sentences.zh: 所以现在如果你愿意的话，听众朋友，请随意暂停这个播客。你可能不会暂停，如果我是你并且处于你现在的位置，我个人是不会的，

sentences.en: not having watched Bryce's talk, maybe you have already.
sentences.zh: 在还没看过布莱斯的演讲的情况下，也许你已经看过了。

sentences.en: Uh, but if you want, if you are so inclined, you can pause this, go watch Bryce's talk.
sentences.zh: 呃，但如果你愿意，如果你有此兴致，你可以暂停一下，去看布莱斯的演讲。

sentences.en: Uh, link will be in the show notes and then you can come back.
sentences.zh: 呃，链接会在节目文稿（show notes）中，然后你可以回来。

sentences.en: Uh, there was just a couple of questions asked in the talk.
sentences.zh: 呃，演讲中刚刚提到了几个问题。

sentences.en: If you did go and pause it.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的去暂停了的话。

sentences.en: And now I shall ask my questions.
sentences.zh: 现在我要提出我的问题了。

sentences.en: First of all, it is not a question, but a comment.
sentences.zh: 首先，这不是一个问题，而是一个评论。

sentences.en: I always, I always forget.
sentences.zh: 我总是，我总是忘记。

sentences.en: And I'm always reminded when I watch one of your talks, Bryce of the shared passion that we have for beautiful, beautiful slides.
sentences.zh: 每当我观看你的演讲时，布莱斯，我都会被我们对美丽、精美幻灯片的共同热情所触动。

sentences.en: You make some of the, I, I mean, I, I usually, uh, to some extent write a quote unquote trip report for every GTC ever since I've been at NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 你制作了一些，我，我的意思是，我，我通常，呃，自我加入英伟达以来，为历届GTC在某种程度上撰写所谓的行程报告（trip report）。

sentences.en: Um, when there was a GTC, cause obviously COVID year, they canceled it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当有GTC的时候，因为显然在疫情那年，他们取消了。

sentences.en: Um, the first one, uh, last year, I think they, because it was the first one back in person, they had some recording issues.
sentences.zh: 嗯，去年的第一场，我想，因为那是回归线下后的第一场，他们有一些录制问题。

sentences.en: And so my trip report kind of fell apart cause I was waiting for Jake Hempstead's, uh, talk to be released to like complete it, but then it never ended up having a recording.
sentences.zh: 所以我的行程报告有点进行不下去了，因为我在等杰克·亨普斯特德（Jake Hempstead）的，呃，演讲发布以便将其完成，但结果最终也没有录像。

sentences.en: Anyways, one of my things I like to do is I like to take screenshots of like the highlights, you know, if I watch
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，我喜欢做的事情之一就是我喜欢截取精彩片段的屏幕截图，你知道的，如果我观看

sentences.en: a Jax or XLA talk and they've got some nice, you know, slide, I take a slide.
sentences.zh: 一个Jax或XLA的演讲，而且他们有一些不错的，你知道的，幻灯片，我就截一张图。

sentences.en: I think I took eight or nine, uh, screenshots of your deck.
sentences.zh: 我想我从你的幻灯片里截了八九张，呃，屏幕截图。

sentences.en: What are some of the, I mean, I'm, I'm going to compare, I haven't finished the what's CUDA all about anyway talk, but there's two different slides.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是，我的意思是，我，我打算比较一下，我还没看完《CUDA到底是什么》（What's CUDA all about anyway）那个演讲，但有两个不同的幻灯片。

sentences.en: One from, I don't, I don't actually know him, but his last name's Armstrong.
sentences.zh: 一个来自，我，我其实不认识他，但他的姓是阿姆斯特朗（Armstrong）。

sentences.en: I think Rob Armstrong, he's giving that talk.
sentences.zh: 我想是罗布·阿姆斯特朗（Rob Armstrong），他在做那个演讲。

sentences.en: He has a GPU versus CPU slide.
sentences.zh: 他有一张GPU对比CPU的幻灯片。

sentences.en: You have a GPU versus CPU slide.
sentences.zh: 你有一张GPU对比CPU的幻灯片。

sentences.en: I don't need to, I don't mean to dunk on Rob slide, but yours
sentences.zh: 我不是故意要贬低罗布的幻灯片，但你的

sentences.en: much chef's kiss, much more beautiful.
sentences.zh: 简直是神仙操作（chef's kiss），美妙得多。

sentences.en: You also have that host slash device with the, uh, the gradient from beautiful, beautiful.
sentences.zh: 你还有那个带有，呃，精美渐变效果的主机/设备（host/device）图表，太美了，太美了。

sentences.en: I saw that and I was like, this is Bryce at his fineSt. Um, anyway, so just, you said you spent the last two weeks on your slides.
sentences.zh: 我看到那个时就想，这就是处于最佳状态的布莱斯。呃，不管怎样，你刚才说你花了两周时间制作幻灯片。

sentences.en: Uh, it definitely shows.
sentences.zh: 呃，这绝对看得出来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's interesting now that, um, a couple of years ago I made the decision that I was going to speak a lot more frequently, but give the same talk more regularly.
sentences.zh: 现在很有意思的是，呃，几年前我做出了一个决定，我要更频繁地演讲，但要更规律地做同一个演讲。

sentences.en: I used to make a talk and I would give a talk once or twice.
sentences.zh: 我过去常常做一个演讲，然后只讲一两次。

sentences.en: And what I decided was I don't want to make three or four or five talks a year.
sentences.zh: 我当时决定的不是每年做三四个或五个演讲。

sentences.en: I want to make one really, really good talk and I want to give it 10 or 20 times a year.
sentences.zh: 我想做一个真正非常非常好的演讲，并且一年讲个十次二十次。

sentences.en: And part of the philosophy is I want to give the talk so many times that it becomes just like, like that I mastered the talk.
sentences.zh: 这种理念的一部分在于，我想把这个演讲讲上无数次，以至于它变得就像，就像我对这个演讲已经了如指掌。

sentences.en: And so I think I make fewer talks, but I put so much more effort into the talk because like I made this talk knowing the reason I was so stressed and pushing so hard for it is I'm
sentences.zh: 所以我想我做的演讲变少了，但我投入到演讲中的精力要多得多，因为就像我做这个演讲时就知道，我之所以压力这么大、这么拼命的原因是，我

sentences.en: gonna, like, I'm immediately turning around.
sentences.zh: 马上，我要掉头就走。

sentences.en: I gave this talk.
sentences.zh: 我做完了这个演讲。

sentences.en: What's, what's today?
sentences.zh: 今天几号？

sentences.en: It's the 20th.
sentences.zh: 是20号。

sentences.en: I gave the talk on the 18th on March 27th.
sentences.zh: 我是3月27日做的这个演讲。

sentences.en: I'm going to be giving the talk in Paris on March 31St. I'm going to be giving the talk in London.
sentences.zh: 我将在3月31日在巴黎做这个演讲。我将在伦敦做这个演讲。

sentences.en: Um, and I'm going to be giving the talk like two or three times a month for the next, uh, you know, uh, eight or 10 months.
sentences.zh: 呃，在接下来的，呃，你知道的，八到十个月里，我每个月要做两三次这个演讲。

sentences.en: And then the other big decision I made is to script all my talks.
sentences.zh: 然后我作出的另一个重大决定是将我所有的演讲都写成脚本。

sentences.en: I have a script of what
sentences.zh: 我有一份关于我

sentences.en: I'm going to say.
sentences.zh: 要说的话的脚本。

sentences.en: And it always amazes me where like, you know, every talk, there's a time target of like how long I'm supposed to make the talk for.
sentences.zh: 而且我总是惊叹于，你知道的，每次演讲都有一个时间目标，比如我这场演讲应该讲多长时间。

sentences.en: And what I, what I always do is I go through and I make all the content.
sentences.zh: 而我，我总是做的事情是，我把所有的内容都过一遍并制作出来。

sentences.en: And then, um, if I has like, I, I, I very rarely
sentences.zh: 然后，嗯，如果我有，我，我，我极少

sentences.en: test how long it takes before I give the talk.
sentences.zh: 在演讲前测试它需要多长时间。

sentences.en: Um, cause I usually give 60 minute talks and I usually just make the content and it happens to fit in 60 minutes just without any thought about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为我通常做60分钟的演讲，我通常只是制作内容，而且它刚好就能塞进60分钟里，完全不需要去考虑这件事。

sentences.en: Um, and sometimes I can just look through and I can just eyeball it the, like, maybe this is too much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有时我只要浏览一下，大概目测一下，比如，也许内容太多了。

sentences.en: Maybe this is too little.
sentences.zh: 也许内容太少了。

sentences.en: In this case, I needed to, to give the talk in 35 minutes.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我需要把演讲控制在35分钟内。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was a little worried about that cause that's not my usual time target.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我对此有点担心，因为这不是我通常的时间目标。

sentences.en: And so I did one dry run through where I went through and ran through my script and it, it ended with like 36 minutes and 24 seconds.
sentences.zh: 所以我做了一次彩排，把我的稿子从头到尾过了一遍，结果时间是36分24秒。

sentences.en: And I was just like, it was perfect.
sentences.zh: 当时我就觉得，这太完美了。

sentences.en: It was just, it somehow hit the perfect length.
sentences.zh: 它刚刚好，不知怎么就达到了完美的长度。

sentences.en: Um, but I, I love, I love scripting the talks because I, I feel like for the most part, after I've given the talk two or three times,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我，我很喜欢，我很喜欢为演讲写稿，因为我觉得大多数情况下，在我讲了两三次之后，

sentences.en: I can do the delivery without it sounding too scripted.
sentences.zh: 我可以在表达时听起来不会太像在念稿。

sentences.en: Um, it'll still sound a little scripted, but I can do the delivery without it sounding too scripted.
sentences.zh: 嗯，听起来可能还是有点像念稿，但我可以在表达时听起来不会太像在念稿。

sentences.en: And, and then I don't have to worry about going off on tangents.
sentences.zh: 然后，我也不用担心会扯到别的事情上去。

sentences.en: I don't have to, once I've got the timing down, I don't have to worry about how long it's going to take.
sentences.zh: 我不必，一旦我掌握了时间，我就不必担心要花多长时间。

sentences.en: I can make it more consistent and a better experience for the people who I'm giving the talk to.
sentences.zh: 我可以让它更稳定，并为听我演讲的人提供更好的体验。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons why I love giving the talk 10 or 20 times is by the time I've gotten to, you know, the 10th time I've given the talk, I've memorized most of the script.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢把一场演讲做10次或20次的原因之一是，等到了，你知道的，我第10次做这场演讲的时候，我已经背下了大部分的稿子。

sentences.en: And so now I'm just, I'm just consistent.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我只是，我只是保持稳定。

sentences.en: It just sounds natural and it's just consistent.
sentences.zh: 听起来很自然，而且很稳定。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Food for thought.
sentences.zh: 引人深思。

sentences.en: I mean, I do not script my talks, but, um, the result of this talk, it's, it's very good.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我演讲是不写稿的，但是，嗯，这场演讲的效果，非常棒。

sentences.en: And like I said, these, and I actually, I went and checked.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这些，实际上我特意去查了一下。

sentences.en: I think I said it was seven or eight.
sentences.zh: 我想我之前说过是七八个。

sentences.en: I took one, two, three, four, five screenshots, five screenshots.
sentences.zh: 我截了一张、两张、三张、四张、五张图，五张截图。

sentences.en: So not, not eight or nine, but definitely the most I've taken of any other talk I've watched is
sentences.zh: 所以不是八九个，但绝对是我看过的所有其他演讲中截图最多的一次，

sentences.en: one, which leads me to, I mean, I'm not going to share screen share because we don't need to,
sentences.zh: 这就让我想到了——我的意思是，我不会分享屏幕，因为没必要，

sentences.en: you'll know the slides I'm talking about, and maybe we'll include it in the show notes by far my favorite slide.
sentences.zh: 你们会知道我在说哪张幻灯片，也许我们会把它收录在节目文稿里，这绝对是我最喜欢的幻灯片。

sentences.en: Be sure to check these show notes either in your podcast app or at adspthepodcaSt.com for links to anything we mentioned in today's episode, as well as a
sentences.zh: 请务必在你的播客应用中或访问adspthepodcaSt.com查看本期节目文稿，获取今天节目中提到任何事物的链接，以及

sentences.en: link to a GitHub discussion where you can leave thoughts, comments, and questions.
sentences.zh: 一个GitHub讨论区的链接，你可以在那里留下想法、评论和问题。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: We hope you enjoyed and have a great day.
sentences.zh: 希望你们喜欢，祝大家有美好的一天。

sentences.en: Low quality, high quantity.
sentences.zh: 低质量，高数量。

sentences.zh: 这就是我们播客的标语。其实不是标语。

sentences.zh: 我们的标语是洒满信息糖粉的混乱。
